study type: Observational study (secondary analysis of a cluster-randomised controlled trial)
exposure: Successful VBAC vs unplanned cesarean section
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 790 women going into labor for planned VBAC at 15 study sites in Ireland, Italy, and Germany.
finding: The pooled successful VBAC rate was 74.6%, with earlier amniotomy, previous vaginal birth, lower infant birthweight, and shorter labour duration being positive predictors of successful VBAC.
